purpose: Retrospectively test whether runtime-observable disagreement and retrieval diagnostics can cross-fit a per-case selector router over the six already frozen CONFLICTS methods, while separately measuring whether FRC contributes beyond the five reproducible baselines.

prior_exposure.interpretation: These values were visible before this protocol file and canonical output were written. The experiment is therefore a transparent retrospective discovery and must not be described as preregistered confirmation.

frozen_router.training_unit: one case-method pair from folds other than the evaluation fold
frozen_router.target: whether the frozen shared classifier prediction for that case-method pair equals the public conflict label
frozen_router.logistic_solver: dependency-free standardized Newton/IRLS binary logistic regression
frozen_router.method_choice: highest predicted correctness probability; frozen method order breaks exact ties

whitelisted_families: own-label vote share and distinct-label share within the variant method set
selected count, token cost, source-domain coverage and lexical diversity
mean, standard deviation, maximum and top margin for BM25, dense, hybrid and cross-encoder scores
mean and maximum for four role scores
pairwise selected-ID Jaccard against methods inside the same variant
feature_contract.gold_usage: training target and reporting metrics only

primary: paired all-router minus static-baseline accuracy with 95% bootstrap interval
secondary: per-label recall delta against the static baseline
all-method and no-FRC oracle upper bounds

decision_policy.next_step: Freeze a genuinely untouched independent routing confirmation before any adoption; do not tune this router further on CONFLICTS.
decision_policy.gate_2: NO-GO/SHADOW regardless of this retrospective result

limitations: The aggregate CONFLICTS outcome and one exploratory router probe were visible before canonicalization.
All six method predictions must be available, increasing inference work relative to one static selector.
The same local Qwen classifier supplies every method prediction and is not an independent expert judge.
A system-level routing gain does not establish that FRC itself outperforms the reproducible baselines.
No expected-behavior human adherence, flood-domain expert evaluation or production traffic is measured.
